title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 13, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B9.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C5.5 (Peaked November 13, 2026 at 18:21 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 377 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

C-Class activity! 🔥🌌

Several bright active regions and a prominent dark filament are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clear outward CME structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
